raw_text: AI-generated images of Indian politicians in fabricated scenarios went viral this week, highlighting the growing challenge of synthetic media during election season. The images, created using a commercial meme generation app called PolitiMeme, were shared without their satirical context on multiple platforms. Fact-checkers Alt News and Vishvas News debunked the images within hours. Election Commission sources told NDTV they are monitoring AI-generated political content and may issue advisory guidelines for platforms.
clean_text: NDTV reports AI-generated political images from PolitiMeme app went viral without satirical context. Fact-checkers debunked within hours. Election Commission monitoring AI-generated political content and considering platform guidelines.
